Red Dead Redemption 2 — Cross-Platform Buying Guide

Xbox / PS5 / PC · Updated 2026-08-05

Red Dead Redemption 2 is Rockstar's 2018 western masterpiece — a story-driven open world widely considered one of the greatest games ever made. Six years on, it's also one of the cheapest premium games you can buy.

What you get

  • Story mode — a 60+ hour single-player epic
  • Red Dead Online — a separate multiplayer mode, included but lightly supported now
  • Ultimate Edition — adds cash bonuses and survival kits; not worth it for story players

Where to buy cheapest

RDR2 sits at its lowest-ever key price. Green Man Gaming routinely beats both the console stores and physical discs, and a digital key means no disc to swap. On PC, compare against Steam sales too.

  • Check Green Man Gaming
  • Check on Amazon
